items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked, with human counsel_required for any rights exception or external outreach. Decision: keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unchanged. Evidence shows Woot API access documentation but no permission for commercial/public display, storage, historical derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate use, or advertising; public terms point against the proposed use. Accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, and owner gates are also blocked. Compliance is technical triage only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry does not block ordinary reversible growth, but it does not support this gated launch. No go-live proposal is supported.

Progress: 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks can be closed on current evidence. The rights packet is verified as blocked; data-flow evidence is partial; consent/analytics evidence is partial; vendor/log/incident evidence is not complete. Keep tracking active. Next evidence actions: attach an authoritative Woot permission or terms record; produce the repository/configuration data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent behavior and GA4 property/data-sharing settings; produce the log-field, vendor/DPA, incident, deletion, and request-handling inventory. Do not send outreach or change the private gate without owner authorization and human-counsel review.

Data-use decisions: Woot deal and price-history data = blocked; missing current written permission, field-level rights, freshness/correction/takedown rules, and affiliate/advertising terms; smallest next action is an owner-authorized draft request through the official Woot process, held unsent pending human counsel. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest next action is a read-only data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review; smallest next action is read-only consent/configuration capture. Operational logs and Cloudflare data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, and incident/request procedures; smallest next action is a read-only operator and vendor inventory. Human counsel is required before resolving jurisdictional privacy questions or approving public data use, affiliate use, advertising, remarketing, or expanded notifications.

For private or parked properties, retain the concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence to each existing readiness packet.
